preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(o1, int) and isinstance(o2, int) and o1 > 0 and o2 > 0 and o1 % 2 == 1 and o2 % 2 == 1 for o1, o2 in testcases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, o1 and o2 are positive odd integers representing the number of states and districts per state, respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(len(districts) == o1 * o2 for districts, (o1, o2) in testcases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of districts is exactly o1 * o2.

preconditions.expression: all(all(d in {0, 1} for d in districts) for districts, (o1, o2) in testcases)
preconditions.description: Each district's representative is either 0 (Zero) or 1 (One).

postconditions.expression: all(output == 1 or output == 0 for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output is either 1 (President can be a One) or 0 (President cannot be a One).

postconditions.expression: all((output == 1) == any(all(sum(d[i:i+o2]) > o2 // 2 for i in state_starts) for state_starts in possible_partitions) for (districts, (o1, o2)), output, possible_partitions in zip(testcases, outputs, possible_partitions_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 1 if there exists a way to partition the districts into o1 states of o2 consecutive districts (circularly) such that the majority of state governors are Ones. Otherwise, the output is 0. A state governor is a One if the majority of its districts are Ones.
